script_logic_check.summary: 8 镜因果链完整：落笔建立 -> 图纸闭合 -> 线稿实体化 -> 成品首秀 -> 细节证明 -> 机构证明 -> 可逆拆装 -> 英雄落台。每镜只有一个主要动作，机位动机明确，相邻镜头无功能性重复。

在爆炸镜头前增加支架收平落点，并要求拆解后回到完全相同的封闭状态。
用高位建立、顶视跟笔、锁定转化、低位环绕、微距滑轨、机构近景、对称爆炸、英雄拉远区分相邻镜头语法。

primary_anchor: 产品锚点：深枪灰/黑色机械装甲手机壳，修长矩形轮廓、厚实倒角护角、左上方高起伏三摄方形护框；背面为不对称机械切面与约四处可见紧固点。
磁环/支架锚点：中央偏下同轴圆形磁吸总成；铰链固定在圆环 6 点方向，窄长支撑臂沿纵向中轴向下，MECH-01 文字方向与支撑臂一致。
侧底锚点：侧边 + / - 长键、其下纹理功能键、三条浅色斜纹；底部中央 USB-C 加厚矩形护圈、左右对称圆形声孔和对称底角缓冲块。
材质锚点：TPU 为哑光细颗粒软质黑；PC 为烟灰半透明硬质结构；合金支架和装饰板为深枪灰喷砂/拉丝金属，倒角窄亮；磁环、螺丝和相机环有冷硬锐利高光。
continuity_rules: 禁止镜像产品：后视图相机岛始终在左上，磁环不偏心，支架始终从 6 点位向下；相机开口、圆环和支架全程同向。
Shot 01-03 共用同一白纸、暖灰桌面、右侧入画手、左前柔光和顶视轴；Shot 03 实体与 Shot 02 完成图外轮廓严格重合，手在实体化后退出且不再出现。
Shot 04 的浅灰产品台由 Shot 03 的纸面亮度自然延展；Shot 04 结尾的产品朝向直接承接 Shot 05，允许变化仅为镜头距离、绕拍角度和移动高光。
Shot 06 结束时支架重新折回并与背板齐平；Shot 07 从这一完整封闭状态开始，拆解后必须恢复同一状态；Shot 08 承接同一成品落台。
爆炸与装配沿唯一前后深度轴进行，固定顺序为手机本体 -> TPU 减震内框 -> PC 硬质背板 -> 磁吸线圈组件 -> 合金支架组件 -> 金属螺丝与衬套 -> 装饰面板组件 -> 外层防护边框；不得漏件、重件、镜像或换序。
允许变化：产品角度、镜头距离、支架开合、组件间距、螺丝旋转和高光位置；禁止变化：产品比例、背板切面、孔位、按钮映射、护角厚度、材质类别和部件数量。
world_lock: 两个空间均保持高级工业产品广告语汇：暖灰哑光桌面/浅灰无缝产品台、左前柔和冷白主光、右后窄轮廓光、低饱和黑灰色域和充足留白。
二维到三维只从既有制图线条隆起并获得厚度，不使用烟雾、粒子、液体、霓虹、全息 UI 或魔法光圈。
不添加额外人物、第二只手、文字卡、技术标注、引线、浮动 UI、虚构品牌、彩色灯光、脏污车间或赛博城市背景。
video_asset_policy: 四张用户图片只控制产品结构、材质、比例、部件关系和细节位置，不锁定各镜头构图。
爆炸参考中的中文标签、引线和裸机 Apple 标识不得进入完成壳体；只使用可见产品结构信息。
线稿阶段仅锁轮廓、构图、动作和空间层次，不表现黑灰材质、透明度、高光或真实文字。
当前流程只到脚本包审批；批准后才并行生成线稿。最终彩帧默认不生成，除非用户明确要求。
所有资产保存在当前 session 的 assets/，JSON 和 HTML 仅记录项目相对路径。

shots.line_art: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: contour-only storyboard line-art for Shot 01. Locked 16:9. FRAME SETUP: premium warm-gray matte workbench, one centered white sheet with all four corners readable, slim ruler fixed upper left, one adult right hand with charcoal cuff entering from lower right holding a black technical pencil; foreground hand, midground paper, sparse background. ACTION PATH: START — pencil tip hovers above the lower-right paper area; PROCESS — the hand draws the phone-case outer silhouette and upper-left camera guard; END — a clear half-finished drawing remains and the pencil stops near the central structure. REPRESENTATIVE FREEZE: draw only the active half-finished state just before the pencil stops; one hand and one drawing state, no ghost poses or arrows. CAMERA PATH: start 35mm high three-quarter wide; make a short slow push; end slightly closer while paper corners, ruler, hand screen side and left-front key direction remain readable. CONTINUITY LOCKS: establishes the exact paper position, ruler position, right-side hand entry and drawing orientation used by Shot 02-03; allowed changes only pencil position and drawing completion. REFERENCE DUTY: product rear reference locks the outer silhouette and upper-left camera-guard geometry only, not composition or rendered materials. CONTOUR-ONLY RULES: thin sparse clean black contours on white; depth only by overlap; no shadow, gray fill, hatching, stipple, texture, material rendering, lighting effects or decorative polish. AVOID: extra hands, face or body, jewelry, mirrored case, complete product appearing early, readable text or logos, labels, arrows, captions, UI or technical overlays.
shots.style_notes: 线稿仅锁工作台地理和半成稿轮廓。
shots.final_prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render / illustration-story. Asset type: final static storyboard frame for Shot 01. Input references: shot01-line.jpg is the authoritative composition, camera, hand placement and half-drawn-state lock; reference-product-rear.png controls only the phone-case design geometry being drawn. Primary request: Generate a final colored photoreal premium industrial-design film frame in locked 16:9. Real image-model raster output only. LOCKED STRUCTURE FROM LINE ART: 35mm high three-quarter wide view of a warm-gray matte workbench; centered natural white paper, slim ruler upper left, one adult right hand with clean nails and charcoal cuff entering lower right with a black technical pencil; freeze as the outer shell and upper-left camera guard are drawn and the pencil nears the central structure. Preserve one hand, one partial drawing state and ample clean negative space. STYLE TRANSLATION FROM TEXT LOCK: high-end industrial product commercial, soft cool-white key from left-front, subtle warm-gray grade, realistic paper fibers, restrained contact shadows, natural skin, premium optical depth, calm precision; drawing remains graphite/ink on paper, not a rendered product. IMPORTANT AVOID: do not change composition, handedness, paper/ruler positions or drawing orientation; no second hand, face, body, jewelry, complete product, readable ruler numerals, text, labels, logos, UI, neon, particles, clutter, concept-art finish or excessive HDR.

shots.line_art: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: contour-only storyboard line-art for Shot 02. Locked 16:9. FRAME SETUP: exact same white sheet, ruler and right hand from Shot 01 in a top-down close view; complete case footprint centered with hand held at the right edge. ACTION PATH: START — continue from the half-finished drawing; PROCESS — add the concentric magnetic ring, six-o'clock downward stand, asymmetric mechanical backplate, reinforced corners, side openings and fastener positions; END — the final line closes the ring and the hand lifts the pencil to the paper's right side. REPRESENTATIVE FREEZE: draw only the instant the last line closes, with the full flat design visible and the hand beginning to lift; no alternate drawing states. CAMERA PATH: start 50mm locked overhead with a slight pencil follow; settle into a fully locked final crop; paper-edge crop, drawing scale and product orientation must become the exact Shot 03 start. CONTINUITY LOCKS: same sheet layout, right hand, light direction and screen side as Shot 01; camera island upper left, ring coaxial, stand at six o'clock pointing down; allowed change only drawing completion and pencil lift. REFERENCE DUTY: rear and side references lock geometry, side openings and fastener locations; do not copy logos, labels or tiny text. CONTOUR-ONLY RULES: thin sparse clean black contours on white; minimal drafting marks only; no shadow, gray fill, hatching, stipple, texture, material rendering, lighting effects or decorative polish. AVOID: mirrored product, early 3D thickness, annotations, arrows, readable text, UI, duplicate hands or missing product anchors.

Shot 08 | 真实产品落地: 浅灰无缝产品台上，精确重组且支架完全收平的手机壳悬浮于后背三分之四角度，左上相机护框、中央同轴磁环、不对称背板与四角保护完整可见。产品缓慢转向后背主视并下降，窄高光依次扫过烟灰 PC 边框、机械背板、合金磁环与螺丝。Camera: 35mm 低位英雄角，先做短轨道环绕，再连续物理拉远；产品稳稳落台，最终在对称宽景中居中锁定。Motion cue: 悬浮成品依次完成转向、下降、接触与静止；左前冷白柔光和右后窄轮廓光保持固定，所有核心结构清晰可读。

Global continuity: 四张产品参考共同代表同一款手机壳，不是不同款式。各 Shot 的文字描述共同锁定构图、起始状态、动作路径、镜头关系和镜间连续性；生成时只需上传主体段所列四张产品参考图，不依赖或要求用户另行上传任何分镜图或最终画面。全片禁止镜像产品，后视相机岛始终左上，磁环始终同轴，支架铰链固定在 6 点位并沿纵轴向下，背板切面、螺钉、孔位、按钮、接口、护角、部件数量和装配顺序不漂移。Shot 01-03 共用同一纸张、右手、入画侧、光向和相机轴，手退出后不再出现；Shot 04-08 共用同一浅灰产品台、左前冷白主光和右后窄轮廓光。材质始终区分哑光 TPU、烟灰半透明 PC、深枪灰合金与冷硬金属紧固件，禁止全部变成亮塑料。二维到三维只由既有线条获得厚度。禁止额外人物或手、虚构品牌、文字卡、标签、引线、漂浮 UI、烟雾、粒子、液体、霓虹、赛博背景、漏件、重件或换序。
